name: ohhnico-github-io
description: Personal site for Nicolo Rengifo, spoken in the platform's language: system typeface, translucent chrome, a bento where no two cards share a layout, blue only where it responds. Tailwind compiles src/input.css to style.css and esbuild bundles src/main.js to app.js; both outputs are committed and are the only stylesheet and the only script the page loads, so the published page makes no third-party requests.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.dev: npm run build:css -- --watch & npm run build:js -- --watch --sourcemap
